doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Overage in Shareholder Resolution on Restricted Stock Awards and Free Acquisition of Treasury Shares
doc_title_jp: 譲渡制限付株式報酬の株主総会決議超過及び自己株式の無償取得に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 譲渡制限付株式報酬の株主総会決議上限超過分の返還

summary_en: Wellnet acquired 897 restricted shares from eight directors at no cost on October 20, 2026, to correct an overage in the restricted stock award program. The directors had received 30,897 shares in November 2025, exceeding the 30,000-share annual cap set by shareholder resolution. Directors agreed to return the excess shares and related dividend equivalents with 3% interest.
summary_jp: 2025年11月に取締役8名に処分した譲渡制限付株式30,897株が株主総会決議の年間30,000株上限を897株超過したため、2026年10月20日付けで超過分897株を取締役から無償取得。取締役が受け取った配当相当額も年3%の利息を付して返還を受ける。
